fact: The roundup says amendments to the Data Protection Act 2012 are in process, would add rules on children's and sensitive data, retention limits, international transfers, impact assessments and privacy by design, and that a draft Data Protection Act, 2025 was published requiring domestic storage of certain data; no month is given for the draft, so 2025 is used.

fact: Communications Minister Sam George said at the ACR2 opening that Ghana has a localisation policy under which local data and traffic processed on clouds outside the country will have to be hosted in Ghana; the document gives no instrument name or compliance date.

NITA's Director General said a draft National Data Centre and Cloud Computing Regulatory Framework, which covers licensing, data localisation, security, sustainability and competition, was under review at a validation workshop in Accra.
